excluded_examples.reason: City readiness, while an alert is active in the region; not a Kyiv-city start announcement.
All-clear is for Cherkasy; Kyiv remains under alert.
Domestic explosion explicitly unrelated to an alert.
Bot update, not a contemporary alert boundary.
Regional alert and possible future city alert, not a current city start.
Expected future all-clear; not an announced end.
Retrospective commentary on a previous alert.
Ambiguous qualification (there is a nuance) rather than an unequivocal boundary bulletin.
Joke, not a reliable contemporary announcement.
